local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = UnitManager.GetUnit(me, 11) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local ux, uy = unit:GetX(), unit:GetY()
if unit:GetMovesRemaining() <= 0 then
    print("ERR:NO_MOVES|Builder has no moves remaining this turn"); print("---END---"); return
end
local plot = Map.GetPlot(ux, uy)
if not plot then print("ERR:NO_PLOT|Invalid plot"); print("---END---"); return end
local impType = plot:GetImprovementType()
if impType < 0 then
    print("ERR:NO_IMPROVEMENT|No improvement on tile (" .. ux .. "," .. uy .. ") to remove"); print("---END---"); return
end
local impInfo = GameInfo.Improvements[impType]
local impName = impInfo and impInfo.ImprovementType or "UNKNOWN"
local opRow = GameInfo.UnitOperations["UNITOPERATION_REMOVE_IMPROVEMENT"]
if not opRow then
    print("ERR:OP_NOT_FOUND|UNITOPERATION_REMOVE_IMPROVEMENT not available in this game version"); print("---END---"); return
end
local params = {}
params[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_X] = ux
params[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_Y] = uy
local canStart = UnitManager.CanStartOperation(unit, opRow.Hash, nil, params, true)
if not canStart then
    print("ERR:CANNOT_REMOVE|Cannot remove " .. impName .. " at (" .. ux .. "," .. uy .. "). Builder must be on the tile with moves and charges."); print("---END---"); return
end
UnitManager.RequestOperation(unit, opRow.Hash, params)
print("OK:REMOVING_IMPROVEMENT|" .. impName .. " at (" .. ux .. "," .. uy .. ")")
print("---END---")
